atoms.text: In Südafrika erhält Zula gerade einen Anruf von ihrer Freundin Milou aus den USA.
atoms.sound: In Südafrika erhält Sula gerade einen Anruf von ihrer Freundin Milou aus den USA.

instruction.text: Vervollständige die Lücken und beantworte die Fragen.
instruction.sound: Vervollständige die Lücken und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.b: Hey Zula!
Hi Milou, it's good to hear from you!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '20%'>Hi Milou, it's good to hear from you!</prosody>

atoms.b: Next week we're going to talk in class about life in other ((++English-speaking Spanish-speaking)) countries. I immediately thought of you as English is an official language in ((++South_Africa Japan)).
Can you tell me some general facts about South Africa?
Sure! South Africa has around 59 million ((++inhabitants mountains)) and three capital cities: Pretoria, ((++Cape_Town Rome)) and Blomfontein.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Sure! South Africa has around 59 million inhabitants and three capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town and Blomfontein.</prosody>

atoms.b: You live in Cape Town, right?
Yes! Another special fact about South Africa is that we have 11 ((++official_languages presidents)). Zulu, Xhosa and Afrikaans are the most widely spoken.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Yes! Another special fact about South Africa is that we have 11 official languages. Zulu, Xhosa and Afrikaans are the most widely spoken.</prosody>

atoms.b: Wow, that's a lot of languages! What about ((++English Russian))?
English is only spoken by about 8% of the population.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>English is only spoken by about 8% of the population.</prosody>

instruction.text: Ziehe die Sprachen Südafrikas an die richtige Stelle im Kreisdiagramm.

atoms.b: Can you tell me something about the history of segregation in South Africa?
Do you mean ((++apartheid stone_age))?

hint.text:
segregation – Trennung
stone age – Steinzeit
apartheid - Apartheid (politisches System der Rassentrennung in Südafrika im 20. Jahrhundert)
hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>segregation</voice> bedeutet Trennung. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>stone age</voice> bedeutet Steinzeit. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>apartheid</voice> bedeutet Apartheid und bezeichnet das politische System der Rassentrennung in Südafrika im 20. Jahrhundert.

atoms.b: That's right!

instruction.text: Vervollständige die Definition von Apartheid, indem du den Satzanfängen die richtigen Enden zuordnest.
instruction.sound: Vervollständige die Definition von Apartheid, indem du den Satzanfängen die richtigen Enden zuordnest.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>racial segregation</voice> bedeutet Rassentrennung. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>oppressive</voice> bedeutet unterdrückend. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>negotiations</voice> bedeutet Verhandlungen.

atoms.b: racial segregation and discrimination that lasted for almost five decades.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Apartheid was a system of racial segregation and discrimination that lasted for almost five decades.</prosody>

atoms.b: divided South Africa into racial groups and limited the rights of the non-white majority.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>The oppressive regime divided South Africa into racial groups and limited the rights of the non-white majority.</prosody>

atoms.b: a combination of internal resistance, international pressure and negotiations.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Apartheid ended through a combination of internal resistance, international pressure and negotiations.</prosody>

atoms.b: Ahh, I remember that a guy named ((++Nelson_Mandela Caesar)) played an important role.
Yes! He played a crucial role for the resistance movement and in ((++challenging supporting)) the apartheid regime.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Yes! He played a crucial role for the resistance movement and in challenging the apartheid regime.</prosody>

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>crucial</voice> bedeutet wichtig oder entscheidend

atoms.b: Do you still notice consequences of the ((++apartheid_regime caste_system))?
Yes, some challenges like high levels of ((wealth ++poverty)) and ((++inequality equality)) still remain, but the government is working to address these issues.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Yes, some challenges like high levels of poverty and inequality still remain, but the government is working to address these issues.</prosody>

atoms.b: Okay, now I definitely know a lot about South Africa. What are you doing later?
I'm going to take some wildlife photos.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>I'm going to take some wildlife photos.</prosody>

atoms.b: Oh right, you take photos of ((++animals buildings)), don't you? Do you mind sending me some? I'd love to show them in class.
Of course not! Check your messages.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '10%'>Of course not! Check your messages.</prosody>

instruction.text: Welche der Bilder hat Zula vermutlich gemacht?
instruction.sound: Welche der Bilder hat Sula vermutlich gemacht?

hint.text: Denke daran, dass Zula Tiere fotografiert.
hint.sound: Denke daran, dass Sula Tiere fotografiert.

atoms.b: Wow, thank you! They look amazing. You are so lucky to have such a unique ((++wildlife city_life)) around you.
That's true! But listen, I really need to go now. We can talk again some other time. Bye!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '20%'>That's true! But listen, I really need to go now. We can talk again some other time. Bye!</prosody>

atoms.b: Thanks for your help! Bye!
